clues: This city lies on a great river delta, ringed by rivers on all sides. One wide river, the Buriganga, runs past its edge.
This city has a clear monsoon time of year. Most of its rain falls from May to the fall, in the wet months.
Long ago, this city was the chief town of Mughal Bengal. Its fine muslin cloth was traded far and wide from here.
Rickshaws with bright art are a famed part of this city's ways. UNESCO counts that rickshaw art as a gem for all mankind.
This is the biggest city in all of Bangladesh, and its seat of rule. The land's top chiefs do their work of state here.
